tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: In a literature class, you mentioned visiting a bookstore that recently opened near campus. A fellow student, Maya, asked you for more information. Write an email to Maya.
bullets: Tell her how you found out about the bookstore.
Describe the bookstore and what you like about it.
Explain what kinds of books you like and invite Maya to visit the bookstore with you.
tasks.subject: New Bookstore Feedback
